scripts.update-external: (cd .. && cd backend && bun update @segwise/core) && (cd .. && cd  backoffice && bun update @segwise/core) && (cd .. && cd  application && bun update @segwise/core)
scripts.deploy:patch: bun run build && bun run bump:patch && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: release v$(bun -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf-8')).version)")" && git tag v$(bun -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf-8')).version)") && git push && git push --tags && bun publish && bun run update-external && clear
